title: Additional controlled mutations from saved summary-derived atomic claims

scope.selection_rule: Original claim must be SUPPORTED by baseline verifier and have matching retrieved relation-family evidence for the attribute being mutated.

aggregate.warning: Controls were selected because the baseline verifier marked them SUPPORTED. Their rerun is a stability check, not an unbiased specificity estimate. All cases use saved extractor claims with deterministic field mutations; claim extraction was not rerun by an LLM.
